text:
emily_csm: Quick sync — Lumenate wants a short-lived egress allowlist and temporary rate uplift for a partner demo in Johannesburg. Renewal flagged as high-touch (renewal 2026-05-15).

omar_infra: Thanks. Need exact CIDRs, target rps, window, and any headers/SNI to allow. Also confirm region (af-south-1).

nisha_lumenate: Region af-south-1 confirmed. CIDRs: 196.25.14.0/24. Peak ~900 rps but they prefer a staged ramp. Window: 2026-04-08T14:00Z for 24h. Allow SNI demo.lumenate.ai and header X-Org-Token.

tara_oncall: Plan: ramp 150 -> 450 -> 900 over 15m, KV prewarm + increased trace sampling 25%. Rollback triggers: 5xx >1.5% sustained 10m or P95 >600ms.

emily_csm: Can we add a renewal touchpoint — I'll run a 15-min post-demo review with the customer and capture feedback for renewal owner.

omar_infra: Draft config I will apply: ```yaml
customer: lumenate
region: af-south-1
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 196.25.14.0/24
ramp_schedule:
  - start: 0m
    qps: 150
  - start: 7m
    qps: 450
  - start: 15m
    qps: 900
duration: 24h
allowed_sni: [demo.lumenate.ai]
allowed_headers:
  - X-Org-Token
prewarm_kv: true
trace_sampling: 25%
rollback_conditions:
  - 5xx > 1.5% for 10m
  - p95 > 600ms for 10m
```

nisha_lumenate: Confirmed — please also allow Host header and make sure JWT peeking is disabled for that header.

omar_infra: Noted, adding Host to allowed_headers and disabling JWT-peek for Host. Queuing change now.

deploybot: deploybot: change queued -> applying to proxy-af-south-1-lumenate. allowlist 196.25.14.0/24 added; ramp schedule deployed; headers X-Org-Token and Host permitted; SNI demo.lumenate.ai allowed; kv prewarm scheduled. https://deploys.redwood.internal/changes/cc-2865

tara_oncall: I'll watch errors, p95, and cache-hit rate. If cache warmup < 60% in first 10m, we'll run on-demand fill and notify the customer.

emily_csm: Great — I'll schedule the post-demo renewal review and drop notes here after the session. :calendar:
